subject: Dealing with missing values of protein-level data in MSstatsTMT

messages.author: 5073dbc11ee9a9df
messages.subject: Dealing with missing values of protein-level data in MSstatsTMT
parts:
Hello, 
sorry if this is an off-topic question, but I really struggle to deal with the missing values.
Around 50% of my protein-level data obtained from proteinSummarization() were NAs. If I excluded proteins which were absent in more than 70% of the samples, then only 40% of the proteins remained in my data.
Because many downstream analysis require complete datasets, I wonder if it is reasonable to simply convert these NAs into zero? Or would it be better if some sorts of imputations were applied? I couldn't find information regarding protein-level imputation in MSstatsTMT vignette, perhaps I should find them somewhere else?

Many thanks, 
LY
